message: Thank you for the comment, Morgan. The pictures are disturbing, and they raise many uncomfortable questions: questions, as you note, about peace, about dignity -- but the flip side to those questions, some people would suggest, are questions about security, about culture. None of them are easy to answer. I'd be curious to hear what conclusions you come to as a result of your research, and would welcome you to post them here, if you're so inclined.
